name: aria-overlay
description: Aria's Live2D character as a transparent desktop overlay
_overrides: pixi-live2d-display lists gh-pages as a runtime dependency, which it is not - it is the tool that publishes their docs site, and nothing in the browser ever loads it. The version it asks for has a critical prototype-pollution advisory, so a public checkout of this repo fails `npm audit` on a package that is never executed. The alternative npm offers is downgrading pixi-live2d-display to 0.3.1, which is the release before Cubism 4 support and would take the character with it.
